name: Identity Consistency Score (ICS)
description: A novel benchmark designed to evaluate the identity consistency of large language models, measuring their ability to maintain a coherent self-model under adversarial pressure, admit uncertainty, and resist manipulation.
reputation: A niche but increasingly cited benchmark in LLM self-consistency and identity-safety discussions, with limited but growing adoption in research on model behavior under adversarial prompting.
notes: Focuses on identity consistency in LLMs; introduced alongside an architectural vision and failure analysis; first benchmark targeting this property.
